n = int(input())
k = int(input())
p = int(input())

MAXN = (1 << 19) | 5

def pow_mod(base, exp):
    res = 1
    cur = base
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = res * cur % p
        cur = cur * cur % p
        exp >>= 1
    return res

def get_lower(x):
    res = 1
    while res < x:
        res <<= 1
    return res

max_pow = get_lower(n + 1) - 1

fact = [1] * (max_pow + 1)
inv_fact = [1] * (max_pow + 1)

for i in range(1, max_pow + 1):
    fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % p

inv_fact[max_pow] = pow_mod(fact[max_pow], p - 2)
for i in range(max_pow - 1, -1, -1):
    inv_fact[i] = inv_fact[i + 1] * (i + 1) % p

cnt = [0] * (max_pow + 1)
for i in range(max_pow + 1):
    cnt[i] = bin(i).count('1')

t = [[0] * (max_pow + 1) for _ in range(20)]
tmp2 = [[0] * (max_pow + 1) for _ in range(20)]
f = [0] * (max_pow + 1)
f[0] = 1

# Initialize tmp2
for i in range(max_pow + 1):
    tmp2[cnt[i]][i] = inv_fact[i]

def transformFWT(arr, length, inv=False):
    temp = arr[:]
    step = 1
    while step < length:
        for j in range(0, length, step << 1):
            for k in range(j, j + step):
                u = temp[k]
                v = temp[k + step]
                if inv:
                    temp[k + step] = (v - u) % p
                else:
                    temp[k + step] = (v + u) % p
        step <<= 1
    if inv:
        inv_len = pow_mod(length, p - 2)
        for i in range(length):
            arr[i] = temp[i] * inv_len % p
    else:
        for i in range(length):
            arr[i] = temp[i] % p

def merge():
    tmp1 = [[0] * (max_pow + 1) for _ in range(20)]
    t_local = [[0] * (max_pow + 1) for _ in range(20)]
    for j in range(20):
        for s in range(max_pow + 1):
            tmp1[j][s] = 0
            t_local[j][s] = 0
    for j in range(max_pow + 1):
        tmp1[cnt[j]][j] = f[j]
    for j in range(20):
        transformFWT(tmp1[j], max_pow + 1)
    for q in range(20):
        for l in range(20):
            if q + l > 19:
                continue
            for s in range(max_pow + 1):
                t_local[q + l][s] = (t_local[q + l][s] + tmp1[q][s] * tmp2[l][s]) % p
    for q in range(20):
        for s in range(max_pow + 1):
            t[q][s] = t_local[q][s]
    tmp3 = [[0] * (max_pow + 1) for _ in range(20)]
    for q in range(20):
        for s in range(max_pow + 1):
            tmp3[q][s] = t[q][s] % p
    for j in range(20):
        transformFWT(tmp3[j], max_pow + 1, inv=True)
    for j in range(max_pow + 1):
        f[j] = tmp3[cnt[j]][j]

def merge_alt():
    tmp = [[0] * (max_pow + 1) for _ in range(20)]
    t_local = [[0] * (max_pow + 1) for _ in range(20)]
    for i in range(20):
        for s in range(max_pow + 1):
            t_local[i][s] = 0
    for q in range(20):
        for l in range(20):
            if q + l > 19:
                continue
            for s in range(max_pow + 1):
                t_local[q + l][s] = (t_local[q + l][s] + tmp2[q][s] * tmp2[l][s]) % p
    for q in range(20):
        for s in range(max_pow + 1):
            tmp[q][s] = t_local[q][s] % p
    for q in range(20):
        transformFWT(tmp[q], max_pow + 1, inv=True)
    for i in range(20):
        for s in range(max_pow + 1):
            tmp2[i][s] = 0
    for i in range(max_pow + 1):
        tmp2[cnt[i]][i] = tmp[cnt[i]][i]
    for i in range(20):
        transformFWT(tmp2[i], max_pow + 1)

if n & 1:
    print(pow_mod(k, n))
    exit()

if n % 2 == 0:
    merge()
    res_k = k
    while k:
        if k & 1:
            merge()
        k >>= 1
        if k:
            merge_alt()

result = (pow_mod(res_k, n) - fact[n] * f[n] % p + p) % p
print(result)
